The source confirms b4 priority, unchecked outer table, selected-null no-op without fallback, complementary prefix/suffix flags and x590 guards.
The consumer tests exactly -1 and +1; the independently read producer and accessor distinguish continuing status 2. Authored-count iteration and guarded animation calls match.
The helper submits once and returns false. Library code confirms copied position, discarded insertion result, allocation/replacement/rejection branches and independent countdown/decay lifetime.
Motion entry supplies animation flags and two-byte metadata; the second byte selects the table whose entries reach the numeric partition consumer.
All motion-configuration branches match, including >0 status, ordinary Kirby/Purin exceptions, all-set b4 success and null-table fallbacks, and anim_id == -1 behavior.
